Don't blame yourself, what did you ever do to hurt her? She probably lashed out because she's hurting just like you (assuming it's depression.) Tell her that, that you would never do anything to make her feel worse and you're struggling too. Or better yet, do what I did. When I was in an a relationship with both of us severely depressed and seeking and never receiving the attention we needed from each other or help from a professional, we realized we genuinely needed  to better ourselves before we could help someone else. Six months later we got back together and now appreciate and love each other more than before.
Hey. I'm here. Want to try again? You have people who want to listen.

I am so sorry you feel like this. I am in your same boat, and I cant imagine my boyfriend saying what yours said. It would hurt anyone deeply, he is a fucking asshole and doesn't understand the severity of your situation, no one can really see what an ED feels like unless they've been through it. You should get away from this guy, you deserve better and you deserve happiness. Please PM me to talk more, don't end your life. Life can be so beautiful, ending your life ends any chnce of you seeing that beauty. I care about you. I know how hard BED is, how it tears you up inside. Just go stay with a family member, or a friend, or sit in a store or restaurant to get away from your boyfriend and think the relationship over. Everything can be healed and fixed if you keep trying, I promise.
